stories.story_fr: Le 28 juin 2025, Fortive a finalise la scission de son segment Precision Technologies via le spin-off de Ralliant Corporation, distribuee aux actionnaires (1 action Ralliant pour 3 actions Fortive). Ralliant cote au NYSE sous RAL depuis le 30 juin 2025. Fortive devient une societe plus simple et plus focalisee.
stories.story_en: On June 28, 2025, Fortive completed the separation of its Precision Technologies segment through the spin-off of Ralliant Corporation, distributed to shareholders (1 Ralliant share for every 3 Fortive shares). Ralliant began trading on the NYSE under RAL on June 30, 2025. Fortive becomes a simpler, more focused company.
stories.signal: On June 28, 2025, Fortive Corporation completed the separation (the Separation) of its Precision Technology segment through the spin-off of Ralliant Corporation

stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, le 'nouveau Fortive' affiche une croissance organique de 5%, une croissance de l'EBITDA ajuste de 13% et une croissance du BPA ajuste de 25%, et se dirige vers la moitie haute de sa fourchette de guidance annuelle 2026 ($2.90 a $3.00 de BPA ajuste).
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, the 'new Fortive' delivered core revenue growth of 5%, adjusted EBITDA growth of 13% and adjusted EPS growth of 25%, and is trending toward the upper half of its FY 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range ($2.90 to $3.00).
stories.signal: We delivered core revenue growth of 5%, adjusted EBITDA growth of 13%, and adjusted EPS growth of 25%
